events.title: Opening & inauguration of Grace Centre
events.description: The Jesus Power School of Ministry and Retreat Center was inaugurated by Rev. Dr. Stephen Wengam, General Superintendent of Assemblies of God Ghana, at Abbeykope, Dawhenya.

events.title: Commissioning of the Apostle Dr. Jones Boateng Library
events.description: The library was commissioned alongside the main facility, opening a collection of more than 3,000 Christian titles to students and the community.

events.title: Matriculation ceremony
events.description: The inaugural matriculation of students into the Jesus Power School of Ministry.

events.title: Graduation & commissioning service
events.description: Students completed their programmes and were commissioned for ministry across Ghana and beyond.

events.title: Free breast screening and health sensitisation
events.description: A free breast screening and breast health sensitisation programme organised by the Reading Club for the community.

events.title: Community health screening
events.description: Health screening for residents, run from the centre with volunteer support.

events.title: Apostle Akomeah Children's Reading Club
events.description: Launched on 28 February 2026 to support children in the community with academic learning while nurturing their spiritual growth.
